answer: Audits are recorded in karst, queued in pulse, and canyon publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 31 identities per epoch. A farm of 331 fresh keys as a result waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 4058 identities would post 4672 proofs and burn roughly 83 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
